# LiteFrame (轻帧)

> Free, open-source, client-side batch image compressor, format converter, and resizer. 100% on-device processing via WebAssembly and Web Workers — zero image uploads, complete privacy.

LiteFrame is an in-browser image optimization workspace for developers, designers, and creators. All operations (compression, resizing, cropping, format conversion) execute locally on your device without server-side processing.

## Key Capabilities
- **Zero Server Uploads**: Processing uses WebAssembly (MozJPEG, OxiPNG, Libavif, SVGO, GifWasm) and Web Workers. No image bytes leave your browser.
- **Batch Processing**: Process multiple images or complete directory structures in one pass.
- **Format Conversion**: Convert across JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF, GIF, and SVG.
- **Visual Comparison**: Side-by-side interactive split-screen diff slider to verify visual fidelity.
- **No Artificial Caps**: No 20-image or 5MB file limits; bounded only by available device memory.
- **Free & Open Source**: MIT Licensed, freely inspectable, with no account registration.

## Format & Engine Matrix
- **JPEG / JPG**: MozJPEG (Wasm), progressive scan, quality scale (0.00-1.00), extreme mode.
- **PNG**: OxiPNG & ImageQuant (Wasm), palette quantization (2-256 colors), dithering control.
- **WebP**: Native browser & Web Worker encoder, lossy/lossless modes, alpha preservation.
- **AVIF**: Libavif (Wasm), modern high-efficiency compression, speed and quality controls.
- **HEIC / HEIF**: In-browser Canvas/Wasm decode, convert to modern web formats (WebP/JPEG/PNG/AVIF).
- **GIF**: GifWasmModule quantization, multi-frame palette optimization, dithering.
- **SVG**: SVGO vector optimization, cleans metadata and redundant code without rasterization.
